summary: TOP Financial Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice. The company has 180 days, until October 26, 2026, to regain compliance by maintaining a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for ten consecutive business days. No transaction, activist campaign, or other special situation is present; the filing is a routine disclosure of a listing standard deficiency. The company may consider a reverse stock split if needed but has not committed to any action. This is not a special situation.
